tools.name: find_programs_by_zip
tools.description: List the federal, state, and county senior-benefit programs that apply where a person lives, from their 5-digit ZIP code or their city and state. Each program includes its cited government source URL, a last-verified date, and an apply-guide link on discoverseniorbenefits.com; spoken_summary is a sh

tools.name: run_eligibility_scan
tools.description: Check which senior-benefit programs a person likely qualifies for, using a deterministic rule engine tied to cited .gov sources — no AI guessing. Requires age plus either zip_code or city + state; every extra field provided turns needs-more-info programs into definite answers. Include marital_status

tools.name: get_program_details
tools.description: Full public details for one program by its id (ids come from find_programs_by_zip or run_eligibility_scan): description, cited government source, how to apply, documents required, and the apply-guide link on discoverseniorbenefits.com. spoken_summary explains it in a few sentences to read aloud.
